request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: The manual of the MA STAR two post lift carries an EC declaration of conformity to Directive 2006/42/EC. For a unit of the same model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, must the CE marking be followed by the identification number of a notified body?

response.text: {"kind": "boolean", "value": true, "text": "Yes. Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed from 20 January 2027 (Art. 51(2) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230, as corrected by CORR.md), so a unit placed on the market on 1 March 2027 falls under that Regulation. Vehicle servicing lifts are listed in its Annex I, Part A, point 3, which requires a Article 25(2) procedure involving a notified body (module B+C, H or G). Under Article 24(3), the CE marking must therefore be followed by the notified body's identification number. The MA STAR manual's declaration cites only Directive 2006/42/EC and names no notified body, so it does not cover a 2027 unit.", "sources": [{"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 24(3) Rules for affixing the CE marking to machinery and related products", "quote": "Where the conformity of machinery or a related product is assessed in accordance with the conformity assessment procedure referred to in Article 25(2), points (a), (b) and (c) and in Article 25(3), points (b), (c) and (d), the CE marking shall be followed by the identification number of the notified body involved in that procedure."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Annex I, Part A, point 3", "quote": "3. Vehicle servicing lifts."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 25(2) Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products", "quote": "Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part A, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (b) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (c) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X."}, {"file": "REG.md", "place": "Art. 51(2) Repeals", "quote": "Directive 2006/42/EC is repealed with effect from 14 January 2027."}, {"file": "CORR.md", "place": "Corrigendum, point 5", "quote": "On page 38, Article 51, paragraph 2, first subparagraph: for: ‘ 14 January 2027 ’, read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."}, {"file": "CORR.md", "place": "Corrigendum, point 10", "quote": "On page 39, Article 54, second paragraph: for: ‘ 14 January 2027 ’, read: ‘ 20 January 2027 ’."}, {"file": "mastar-manual.md", "place": "p. 37 Original EC Declaration of Conformity", "quote": "Richtlinien | Directives 2006/42/EG 2006/42/EC 2014/53/EU 2014/53/EU"}]}
